title: Strip resourceVersion before creating or updating v2 dashboards
answers: Why does creating or saving a new dashboard fail when resourceVersion is set?
How should resourceVersion metadata be handled when saving dashboards in v2 API?
Where is resourceVersion stripped during dashboard save in v2?
body:
Symptom: Creating a new dashboard in v2 fails when metadata has resourceVersion set.
Root cause: public/app/features/dashboard/api/v2.ts:K8sDashboardV2API.saveDashboard only deleted metadata.resourceVersion on update requests, leaving it present on create requests.
Fix pattern: Strip metadata.resourceVersion unconditionally before branching on create vs update.
Constraints: Applies to dashboard saves in K8sDashboardV2API; resourceVersion must not be sent when creating or updating dashboards.
applies: Dashboard save operations in the v2 K8s dashboard API
